(3/7)
• Castes & Rival
Probes: `HARVESTER`,

`ARCHITECT` &
`SENTINEL` claim
`ColonyOrderBoard`

`SymbiontTemperament`.

Post-Matriarch
Sovereign Hive Colony
(4/7)
• Territorial Memory:
each Nexus or
outpost learns from
local incidents. Two
similar incidents open
a trial; two successful
outcomes establish
the behavior.

Post-Matriarch
Sovereign Hive Colony
(5/7)
• Habits: sites can
learn courier
escorts, rest before
returning, or taking
turns collecting. The
first memory is
learned automatically;
adopt a second tested
behavior in `Memory`.

Post-Matriarch
Sovereign Hive Colony
(6/7)
• Teaching: in
`Memory`, select a
source site and
destination. A courier
carries the learned
memory; the
destination tests it
through its own work.
• Bio Scanner: use on
`symbiotic_node`
(dialect/trials) or

symbiont (lesson
role). Forgetting
clears site history.

Sovereign Hive Colony
(7/7)

(`ColonyDialect`): in
`Dialect` pick teacher,
apprentice & pulses
(`1–3·1–3`), clear
conflicts & call via
`sovereign_command_s
taff`.
